code='''from collections import Counter, defaultdict, deque

def _components(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set(); out = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r, c) in seen: continue
            color = grid[r][c]; q = [(r, c)]; seen.add((r, c)); cells = []
            for x, y in q:
                cells.append((x, y))
                for a, b in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
                    if 0 <= a < h and 0 <= b < w and (a,b) not in seen and grid[a][b] == color:
                        seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
            out.append((color, cells, (min(x for x,y in cells), min(y for x,y in cells))))
    return out

def _is_corner(cells):
    s = set(cells); r0=min(r for r,c in s); r1=max(r for r,c in s)
    c0=min(c for r,c in s); c1=max(c for r,c in s)
    if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2: return False
    for vr, vc in ((r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)):
        if s == ({(r,vc) for r in range(r0,r1+1)} | {(vr,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)}):
            return True
    return False

def _vline(cells):
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    return max((c0,c1), key=lambda c: sum((r,c) in cells for r in range(r0,r1+1)))

def _shape(cells):
    forms=[]
    for k in range(4):
        pts=[]
        for x,y in cells:
            if k==0: a,b=x,y
            elif k==1: a,b=y,-x
            elif k==2: a,b=-x,-y
            else: a,b=-y,x
            pts.append((a,b))
        ma=min(a for a,b in pts); mb=min(b for a,b in pts)
        forms.append(tuple(sorted((a-ma,b-mb) for a,b in pts)))
    return min(forms)

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=_components(g)
    marks=[x for x in comps if x[0]!=bg and _is_corner(x[1])]
    if not marks: return g
    marker=max(marks,key=lambda x:len(x[1])); markcolor=marker[0]; vc=_vline(marker[1])
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    for x in comps:
        if x is marker or x[0]==bg: continue
        groups[_shape(x[1])].append(x)
    candidates=[]
    for shape, vals in groups.items():
        if len(vals)<2: continue
        target=max(vals,key=lambda x:(x[2][0],-x[2][1]))
        if target[2][1] < vc:
            candidates.append((len(shape),target))
    # Prefer a repeated multi-cell motif; use repeated isolated cells only when
    # no eligible multi-cell motif lies to the left of the marker stem.
    multi=[x for x in candidates if x[0]>1]
    pool=multi if multi else candidates
    if not pool: return g
    _, target=max(pool,key=lambda x:(x[1][2][0],-x[1][2][1],x[0]))
    for r,c in target[1]: g[r][c]=markcolor
    return g
'''

code2='''from collections import Counter, defaultdict

def _components(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r,c) in seen: continue
            color=grid[r][c]; q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            for x,y in q:
                cells.append((x,y))
                for a,b in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
                    if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and (a,b) not in seen and grid[a][b]==color:
                        seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
            out.append((color,cells,(min(x for x,y in cells),min(y for x,y in cells))))
    return out

def _corner_info(cells):
    s=set(cells); r0=min(r for r,c in s); r1=max(r for r,c in s); c0=min(c for r,c in s); c1=max(c for r,c in s)
    if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: return None
    for cr,cc,rs,cs in ((r0,c0,1,1),(r0,c1,1,-1),(r1,c0,-1,1),(r1,c1,-1,-1)):
        expected={(r,cc) for r in range(r0,r1+1)} | {(cr,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)}
        if s==expected: return cr,cc,rs,cs
    return None

def _shape(cells):
    forms=[]
    for k in range(4):
        p=[]
        for x,y in cells:
            if k==0:a,b=x,y
            elif k==1:a,b=y,-x
            elif k==2:a,b=-x,-y
            else:a,b=-y,x
            p.append((a,b))
        ma=min(a for a,b in p); mb=min(b for a,b in p)
        forms.append(tuple(sorted((a-ma,b-mb) for a,b in p)))
    return min(forms)

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=Counter(v for row in out for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=_components(out)
    marks=[x for x in comps if x[0]!=bg and _corner_info(x[1])]
    if not marks: return out
    marker=max(marks,key=lambda x:len(x[1])); color=marker[0]; corner=_corner_info(marker[1])
    cr,cc,rs,cs=corner
    def is_inside(obj):
        cells=obj[1]
        mr=sum(r for r,c in cells)/len(cells); mc=sum(c for r,c in cells)/len(cells)
        return (mr-cr)*rs>0 and (mc-cc)*cs>0
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    for obj in comps:
        if obj is marker or obj[0]==bg: continue
        groups[_shape(obj[1])].append(obj)
    candidates=[]
    for shape, vals in groups.items():
        inside=[x for x in vals if is_inside(x)]
        outside=[x for x in vals if not is_inside(x)]
        if inside and outside:
            target=max(outside,key=lambda x:(x[2][0],-x[2][1]))
            candidates.append((len(shape),target))
    if not candidates: return out
    multi=[x for x in candidates if x[0]>1]
    pool=multi if multi else candidates
    _, target=max(pool,key=lambda x:(x[1][2][0],-x[1][2][1],x[0]))
    for r,c in target[1]: out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
